There’s no "right" way to dress—it’s about what makes *you* feel powerful. 2. **Body Positivity**: High heels and dresses can be tools for self-expression, especially if they help you stand taller (literally and figuratively). The way you carry yourself matters just as much as what you wear. 3. **Experiment**: If you enjoy this look, try playing with textures, colors, or accessories to keep it fresh.
